title: Temperature-transfer magnon noise
timing_contract: All 77, 293 and 389 K traces were used for whole-temperature leave-out development; all 195 and 352 K traces were reserved. Field traces and frequency bins are nested within temperature. Source background subtraction is retained and disclosed; it is not fitted by this campaign.
calibration: No held-condition calibration. Publisher background subtraction retained, not refitted.
independent_unit: Entire termination temperature; magnetic-field traces nested. One74nm YIG film, frequencies dependent.
scope_limits: Entire termination temperature; magnetic-field traces nested. One74nm YIG film, frequencies dependent.

The measured thermal peak/dip response is reproducible with a compact Lorentzian family across two reserved termination temperatures. The extra dispersive term is effectively tied with the symmetric control; no new magnon law is established.
No independent population confidence interval from dependent rows.

exposure.historical: Internal confirmation reserved until FREEZE.json; schema-stage exposures documented in SOURCE_AND_UNITS.md.
exposure.current: All confirmation outcomes exposed to future users.

uncertainty_policy: Report individual top-level groups and their range; no row-bootstrap population inference.
aggregation: Equal group weight then equal eligible rows within group.
eligibility: Nonfinite native values excluded with anchors; none excluded by fit residuals. All source bytes unchanged.
native_adapter: native.py at scenario research root; shared benchmark integration supplies canonical adapter registration
reference_selection: Min primary error with simpler coefficient count within1percent; retain all controls even if superior.
physical_bounds: PSD nonnegative, termination temperature not film temperature.
